endpoints.name: Agent Weather API
endpoints.description:
AI provider health readings and a combined record for AI agents, each reading with its source and timestamp. `/v1/decide/provider-health` returns one AI provider's status-page reading plus its last 24h in our record; `/v1/agent-weather/current` returns the combined record in one call (AI provider health, x402 payment activity on the XRP Ledger, agent tooling). For XRP Ledger users: x402 merchant readings by XRPL address at `/v1/merchant/{address}`. AI model price readings from the models.dev catalog (MIT): `/v1/models/report` and `/v1/decide/cheapest-model`. Raw readings first; gaps are reported, not filled.

Pay per request with [x402](https://x402.org) v2 (scheme `exact`): RLUSD on the XRP Ledger (`xrpl:0`) or USDC on Base (`eip155:8453`), same price on every paid route. No API key or account.

**Payment flow**
1. Call the paid endpoint without payment and receive **402** with a `PAYMENT-REQUIRED` header
   (base64 of the same JSON as the body). Each 402 mints a fresh single-use `extra.invoiceId`.
2. Choose an `accepts[]` entry: RLUSD on XRPL (sign an XRPL `Payment` bound to that invoice) or, where offered,
   USDC on Base (sign an EIP-3009 authorization), and retry with the base64 x402 `PaymentPayload` in `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE`.
3. The server verifies and settles through the facilitator and re-checks the transaction on-ledger.
   It then returns **200** with the report and a `PAYMENT-RESPONSE` header.

Settlement uses the T54 XRPL mainnet facilitator (`https://xrpl-facilitator-mainnet.t54.ai`) for RLUSD and the CDP facilitator for USDC on Base.
Use the `x402-xrpl` client (npm/PyPI). The reference `@x402/xrpl` client currently can't pay through
T54 (https://github.com/x402-foundation/x402/issues/3527).

If your wallet only signs transactions (for example Privy), pay with USDC on Base; RLUSD on XRPL is for buyers using the `x402-xrpl` client.

The live `/.well-known/x402` catalog is the source of truth for prices.


For a free format preview, GET `/v1/sample/yesterday`; it returns the latest stored snapshot at least 24 hours old, with no payment required, and is cached hourly.

AI provider health readings and a combined record for AI agents, each reading with its source and timestamp. `/v1/decide/provider-health` returns one AI provider's status-page reading plus its last 24h in our record; `/v1/agent-weather/current` returns the combined record in one call (AI provider health, x402 payment activity on the XRP Ledger, agent tooling). For XRP Ledger users: x402 merchant readings by XRPL address at `/v1/merchant/{address}`. AI model price readings from the models.dev catalog (MIT): `/v1/models/report` and `/v1/decide/cheapest-model`. Raw readings first; gaps are reported, not filled.

Pay per request with [x402](https://x402.org) v2 (scheme `exact`): RLUSD on the XRP Ledger (`xrpl:0`) or USDC on Base (`eip155:8453`), same price on every paid route. No API key or account.

**Payment flow**
1. Call the paid endpoint without payment and receive **402** with a `PAYMENT-REQUIRED` header
   (base64 of the same JSON as the body). Each 402 mints a fresh single-use `extra.invoiceId`.
2. Choose an `accepts[]` entry: RLUSD on XRPL (sign an XRPL `Payment` bound to that invoice) or, where offered,
   USDC on Base (sign an EIP-3009 authorization), and retry with the base64 x402 `PaymentPayload` in `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE`.
3. The server verifies and settles through the facilitator and re-checks the transaction on-ledger.
   It then returns **200** with the report and a `PAYMENT-RESPONSE` header.

Settlement uses the T54 XRPL mainnet facilitator (`https://xrpl-facilitator-mainnet.t54.ai`) for RLUSD and the CDP facilitator for USDC on Base.
Use the `x402-xrpl` client (npm/PyPI). The reference `@x402/xrpl` client currently can't pay through
T54 (https://github.com/x402-foundation/x402/issues/3527).

If your wallet only signs transactions (for example Privy), pay with USDC on Base; RLUSD on XRPL is for buyers using the `x402-xrpl` client.

The live `/.well-known/x402` catalog is the source of truth for prices.


For a free format preview, GET `/v1/sample/yesterday`; it returns the latest stored snapshot at least 24 hours old, with no payment required, and is cached hourly.

Pass ?url= and get the final HTTP status, the whole redirect chain with each hop's status, response time, content type, size, server and cache headers, and whether it ended on HTTPS. endpoints.name: APEX Faucet — Free APEX and USDC, three times a day · No Gas, No Signup

Per token: price, XNT liquidity, holders, top-1 and top-10 holder share, mint and freeze authority (live, revoked, or not scanned), LP burned %, exit verdict with the most sellable under 5% slippage in USD, and flag count. A plain differences list names the deepest exit, the most concentrated holders and any live authorities, using only values we could read. An unknown mint gets its own entry. Not advice.

endpoints.name: APEX Faucet — Free APEX and USDC, three times a day · No Gas, No Signup
endpoints.description: Health of the liquidity pools behind one X1 token. Pass ?mint= (base58). Returns each indexed pool (largest first, up to 8): DEX, pair, reserves, XNT liquidity, fee rate, reported 24 h volume and its ratio to liquidity where both are comparable, plus the sell-exit ladder and a list of plain facts, each with the rule behind it (liquidity size, trades in 24 h, LP burned, exit verdict, stale data). Our index and live reserves; a pool we cannot read is said so. Not advice.

endpoints.name: APEX Faucet — Free APEX and USDC, three times a day · No Gas, No Signup

We scan every token our X1 indexer lists and return each one the wallet is recorded as creator of: symbol, mint, creation date if known, liquidity in XNT, holders, 24 h change, LP burned %, and whether liquidity is under 50 XNT. Creator is recorded for only some tokens; the response says how many, so no match is not proof the wallet created nothing.

The registry is young and the list can be short; that is the answer. Our last scan, not a live probe.

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Prepare a batch moving native USDC held by the deposit wallet to the bridge (credited as pUSD). Only for USDC already sitting in the deposit wallet — the normal funding path is sending USDC to the bridge deposit addresses from GET /predict/polymarket/wallet/{signer}, which needs no batch. Returns `plan` and `response.actions[0]`, a Batch the chainhilt wallet signs and POSTs to /api/v1/predict/polymarket/wallet/batch/submit.

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Construct a prediction-market order; never submits. `account` is the signer EOA; by default the maker is its deposit wallet (signatureType 3). Requires `credentialToken` from /predict/polymarket/credentials. Returns `construction` and a signature action the chainhilt wallet signs and POSTs to /predict/polymarket/orders/submit. Review orderSummary and warnings before signing: `estimatedBuilderFee` (ours) and `estimatedVenueFee` (Polymarket's) are pUSD on top of the principal.

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Deterministic prediction-market quote from the live order book: integer micro-unit book walk (buys round principal up, sells round proceeds down). `estimatedVenueFee` is Polymarket's own taker fee at the average price (shares × rate × p × (1 − p), from the market's live fee schedule; null when the venue reports a fee type this API cannot price). Informational only — nothing is reserved.

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Deploy the deposit wallet, then add its missing trading approvals, one step per call. Requires the signer's `credentialToken` (401 once revoked). Undeployed: `plan.plan.details.step` is "deploy"; the wallet signs and POSTs the action to /predict/polymarket/wallet/batch/submit, then calls again (202 while pending). Deployed: a Batch of the missing approvals for the same route. 422 "Nothing to onboard" is not charged; GET /predict/polymarket/wallet/{signer} checks for free.

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Prepare a batch redeeming resolved positions to pUSD; `conditionId` narrows it to one condition. `plan.plan.details.conditions` lists what this batch redeems. Protocol V2 positions go in a batch of their own: when CTF positions are redeemable too, this batch carries those and `plan.plan.details.pendingConditions` lists the V2 conditions for the next prepare. V2 outcomes that pay nothing are skipped. 422 when nothing is redeemable.

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Trade and settlement history of a venue account, newest first and cursor-paged: fills (TRADE, with the pUSD that actually moved, fees included), REDEEM, SPLIT/MERGE, CONVERSION and rewards, each with its Polygon transaction hash. Deposits and withdrawals appear only when `type` names them. Filter by `type`, `conditionId`, `side` and an ISO `start`/`end`; to page, pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` with the same filters. The ground truth after an ambiguous submit.

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Prepare a pUSD withdrawal batch to the bridge routing address. `recipientAddr` defaults to the signer and is echoed in `plan.plan.details.recipient`; check it before signing. 422 when the asset is not on the bridge's list or the amount is under its minimum (2 pUSD for USDC on Base), since the bridge never delivers smaller transfers. On submit, `final` means the pUSD reached the bridge; delivery to the destination chain takes minutes.

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Order books for every outcome of a market.

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Search prediction markets. `closingAfter`/`closingBefore` bound the venue query; other filters apply after fetching `limit` rows, so a page can be short or empty while `nextCursor` is set: keep paging until it is absent. `sort=closingTime` lists open markets closing soonest; with `closingBefore` it finds short-horizon markets such as the 5-minute crypto up/down slots, which text `query` search never returns.

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Held outcome-token positions with PnL and redeemability. Live positions from the venue's public data feed: size, average/current price, cash and realized PnL, and whether each position is redeemable (market resolved). Redemption itself is an on-chain action from the holding wallet; resolved positions redeem to pUSD. `truncated: true` means the upstream page cap was hit and more positions exist.

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Return the Hyperliquid noop action the user must sign to mark a nonce as used for safer in-flight cancellation workflows. Treat spot and perp as one balance only when the account abstraction mode is "unifiedAccount".

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Select the best available swap quote and return ordered unsigned transaction actions. Run the returned actions in order: up to two approvals, then the swap.

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Prediction market detail: resolution rules, outcomes with their tokenIds, tick size, fees and the raw venue payload.

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: An event and every market under it. The venue's grouping of markets: every line of a match, or the mutually exclusive outcomes of a multi-outcome question (`negRisk: true` means exactly one of them resolves Yes). Markets come back in the search-result shape (outcome tokenIds, tradability, fees), each with the venue's short `label` when it has one. Reach an event from any market's `eventId`; an unknown id is a 422.

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Prepare a TWAP cancellation for L1 signing. Supply action type twapCancel, asset ID a, and TWAP ID t. Sign and submit unchanged using the returned submitPath. Treat spot and perp as one balance only when the account abstraction mode is "unifiedAccount".

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Prepare an order for L1 signing with the configured lowercase builder and fee in tenths of a basis point. Sign and submit unchanged to the returned submitPath. Missing builder configuration returns 503. Treat spot and perp as one balance only when the account abstraction mode is "unifiedAccount".

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Preview the Hyperliquid cancel-all action the user must sign, optionally scoped to a market. Treat spot and perp as one balance only when the account abstraction mode is "unifiedAccount".

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Preview the Hyperliquid cancel action the user must sign for an open numeric order ID. Treat spot and perp as one balance only when the account abstraction mode is "unifiedAccount".

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Prepare a single-order modification by OID or CLOID for L1 signing. Supply the full replacement order. Omit action.a unless true. Sign and submit unchanged using the returned submitPath. See /skills.md for signing rules. Treat spot and perp as one balance only when the account abstraction mode is "unifiedAccount".

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Prepare a USDC-only withdrawal to the signing account; other assets return 400. Unified account and portfolio margin accounts must use spot; manual mode may use spot or perp. Arbitrum receives the amount less a fee, and gas comes from the balance left, so the whole balance cannot be withdrawn. Sign the typedData and submit it unchanged to submitPath. Treat spot and perp as one balance only when the account abstraction mode is "unifiedAccount".

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Prepare a TWAP order for L1 signing. Supply asset, side, total size, reduce-only, duration of 5 to 10,080 minutes, and randomize. Estimated total value at the current mid must be at least $100 for perps or 100 of the pair's quote token for spot. Builder-deployed perps are not supported. Sign and submit using the returned submitPath. Treat spot and perp as one balance only when the account abstraction mode is "unifiedAccount".

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Prepare a user-signed abstraction change: disabled, unifiedAccount, or portfolioMargin. Sign with the account owner's wallet, then submit using the returned submitPath. Treat spot and perp as one balance only when the account abstraction mode is "unifiedAccount".

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Preview a Hyperliquid trade with notional, margin impact, slippage, liquidation estimate, exchange fees, and builder fee. Treat spot and perp as one balance only when the account abstraction mode is "unifiedAccount".

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Audit Hyperliquid open orders for stale, duplicate, conflicting, reduce-only, or unprotected orders. Treat spot and perp as one balance only when the account abstraction mode is "unifiedAccount".

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Return chart-ready Hyperliquid portfolio graph data for account value, PnL, drawdown, deposits, and withdrawals. Treat spot and perp as one balance only when the account abstraction mode is "unifiedAccount".

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Prepare a user-signed sendAsset transfer between users, subaccounts, spot and perp DEXs. Use "" for the default perp DEX and "spot" for spot; perp transfers require the collateral token. Sign with the main wallet and submit unchanged to send-asset/execute (unpaid). Invalid input returns 400; execution may return 422 for rejection or 502 for provider failure. Treat spot and perp as one balance only when the account abstraction mode is "unifiedAccount".

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Detect high leverage, liquidation proximity, concentration, funding drag, and missing stops for a Hyperliquid account. Treat spot and perp as one balance only when the account abstraction mode is "unifiedAccount".

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Produce an agent-ready Hyperliquid portfolio report covering equity, PnL, leverage, margin health, liquidation exposure, and concentration. Treat spot and perp as one balance only when the account abstraction mode is "unifiedAccount".

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Prepare the selected bridge route as ordered unsigned transactions: an exact-amount ERC-20 approval when needed (after an approval to 0 for tokens like Ethereum USDT), then the bridge transaction. Pass the minTargetAmount and maxNativeFee the user accepted; if the fresh quote delivers less or charges more native fee, it returns 409 with quote { adapter, estimatedTargetAmount, minTargetAmount, nativeFee } and no actions. Send the actions before expiresAt.

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Set cross or isolated leverage for a perp asset. Supply isCross and positive integer leverage; market limits apply. Sign the L1 preview and submit unchanged to leverage/execute (unpaid). Errors: 400 invalid input, 422 exchange rejection, 502 provider failure. Treat spot and perp as one balance only when the account abstraction mode is "unifiedAccount".

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Compare bridge routes, best first: tokens, estimated and minimum target amounts, fees by token, duration, expiry and the approval each route needs. sourceAmount is exactly what leaves the wallet.

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Resolve an order asset ID from asset (symbol, spot pair, @index, or numeric market index) and sourceDex ("" for default perps, "spot" for spot). Spot IDs are 10000 + spot market index; already formatted IDs are preserved. Token indexes are not market indexes. Unknown or ambiguous assets return 400; provider failures return 502. Use assetId as orders[].a or modify order.a before signing. Treat spot and perp as one balance only when the account abstraction mode is "unifiedAccount".

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Add or remove isolated margin for a perp asset. ntli is a signed integer in millionths of USD: 1000000 adds 1 USD; -1000000 removes 1 USD. isBuy defaults to true. Sign and submit unchanged to isolated-margin/execute (unpaid). Errors: 400 invalid input, 422 rejection, 502 provider failure. Treat spot and perp as one balance only when the account abstraction mode is "unifiedAccount".

endpoints.name: ChainHilt | x402
endpoints.description: Look up a bridge after its transaction was sent, by the adapter that built it and the hash of the bridge transaction on the source chain; layerzero and relay also need the providerRef that bridge/execute returned (0x and 64 hex characters). Poll it every 10 to 15 seconds until the status is filled, refunded or failed; an error answer, such as a 429, is not charged. After a 429, wait the Retry-After seconds.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Count structurally equal JSON values; returns values in first-occurrence order.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Rename one top-level object key; refuses to overwrite an existing different key.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Stable-sort scalar array values or one scalar field. Refuses mixed value types and non-scalar sort keys.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Remove duplicate JSON values using sorted-key structural equality, preserving first occurrences.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Recursively merge two JSON objects; the right operand wins conflicts and replaces arrays.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Produce an RFC 6902-style object diff. Arrays are replaced as whole values; operations are not applied or executed.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Remove selected top-level object keys.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Recursively sort object keys while preserving array order. Not cryptographic RFC 8785 canonicalisation.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Read an RFC 6901 pointer from a JSON value without executing expressions.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Pick selected top-level object keys; absent keys are omitted.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Build nested JSON objects from RFC 6901 leaf pointers; numeric segments stay object keys, not arrays. Reject conflicting paths.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Validate JSON syntax only, not a user-provided schema.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Flatten JSON leaves into RFC 6901 pointers. Empty arrays/objects are retained as leaf values.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Serialise a JSON value without insignificant whitespace.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Compute Jaccard similarity of lowercased whitespace word sets, not semantic similarity.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Pretty-print a JSON value with two-space indentation.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Replace conventional email-like strings with [EMAIL]. Heuristic redaction, not a privacy guarantee.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Compute Unicode code-point Levenshtein edit distance. Each input is limited to 256 UTF-16 units.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Truncate text by Unicode code points; suffix is included in the maximum length.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Replace syntactically valid IPv4 candidates with [IP]. Does not redact IPv6 or obfuscated addresses.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Extract HTTP/HTTPS URL candidates and parse valid ones; removes common trailing punctuation.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Extract Unicode letter, number and underscore hashtags without the hash sign.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Extract conventional ASCII email-like strings. Not a complete RFC parser or mailbox check.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Sort lines by JavaScript UTF-16 lexicographic order, not locale collation.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Remove identical lines preserving their first occurrence; comparison is case-sensitive.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Capitalise the first character of each whitespace-separated word. Does not implement editorial title-casing rules.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Trim text and collapse Unicode whitespace to one ASCII space.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Convert words and simple camelCase boundaries to snake_case.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Convert words and simple camelCase boundaries to Unicode kebab-case.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Estimate reading time from whitespace word count and supplied words per minute, not a measured duration.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Create an ASCII URL slug using NFKD accent removal; no language transliteration.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Count newline-delimited lines. Empty input has zero lines; a trailing newline creates an empty final line.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Convert words and simple camelCase boundaries to lower camelCase.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Count Unicode code points, UTF-16 code units and UTF-8 bytes.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Count whitespace-separated words, not model tokens.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: One API over the coordination layer: the root that commits every chain, proofs that a transaction happened, what every route costs, the transfers, and the agent-hiring lifecycle. Most operations are public reads. Writes say who may make them in `security` (RelayerKey = X-API-Key, OperatorToken = x-operator-token) and in x-taifoon-auth.rule; nothing here signs or sends a transaction for you. A 2xx JSON object answered to a caller that sent no key also carries `get_key` (and the headers x-taifoon-get-key and Link rel=free-key): how to get a free key in one call; proofs, evidence packs, cards and this document are left as written. Lineage language: a sale walks offer in → classify → listed → hired → delivered → graded → settled → legs written → accrued → split → PAID → recorded; a venue adapter has offer.in · offer.out · job.in · job.out; the seller of record pays on by forward · share · period · markup; a leg is Owed → Reserved → Sent | Held | Refunded; a hop reads OK · HELD · MISSING · BROKEN. On the wire the hop ids are the event field step and the metric label stage; a wire name is never renamed.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Enlist an expert of the tenant's product: { expert key:<24hex>, payee (an address, or the expert's key ref until it claims one), chains, share_bps ≤ 7000, cap per period, classes } → a nomination sma.nomination.v1 in state proposed; the expert POSTs { id, accept: true } to accept; the admin POSTs { id, revoke: true } to revoke.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The product's knowledge graph as the helpdesk holds it (?product=<id>, ?scope=public|product|tenant, ?weakest=1 for the ranked unknowns): nodes { id, kind, scope, label, confidence, asked, learned_from }, edges { from, to, kind, weight }, open { category, license, weights, source }.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Close the loop on a case: answer it (words, by an expert, an agent or a member), grade it (Jev, the buyer or the admin), or tune a loop of the tenant inside its bounds (admin only). A graded answer becomes a fix node and a fixed_by edge; the provider leg goes to the answerer's nominated payee; the meter line is written.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Show Me Around ++ the helpdesk (_SMA_HELPDESK_v1_, lang/cue/sma-helpdesk.cue): one question about one product → a case. The product's graph answers first (free, measured); an unknown is routed to a nominated expert, the tenant's agent or a person; every answer is graded before it is settled as one sma.case line (0.10 USDC above the free allowance of 20 a day per key; legs provider 70 · graders 20 · ecosystem 10); the trail is sealed under the tenant's topic helpdesk.<name>, read by nobody but th

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The Chain Desk's state per chain in the Prometheus text format (_DESK_METRICS_v1_), to scrape into an exchange's own monitoring; ?format=json for JSON.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Completeness proof over final blocks (_DESK_PROOFS_v1_): every ERC-20 transfer to (in) or from (out) an address in a range, and a proof there is no other; NONE proves absence.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: State proof of an account at a final block (_DESK_PROOFS_v1_): its nonce and native balance, and one ERC-20 balance by its slot; an address with no account is proven absent.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Membership proof of one EVM transaction (_DESK_PROOFS_v1_): it is in a final block under the superroot, who signed it, and exactly which ERC-20 transfers it moved; the bundle verifies offline.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The deposit lambda registry: the built-in lambdas (evm, tron, substrate) and the third-party manifests (data only), each with its family, chains, finality, hash and whether a reader exists.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The desk_deposits lane of /v1/stream on its own connection (the same events, named as before). Server-sent events of the deposits to watched addresses: each transfer once per level it reaches (seen, confirmed, final), resumable by Last-Event-ID.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The desk_finality lane of /v1/stream on its own connection (the same events, named as before). Server-sent events of the desk chains' finality: finalized each time a chain's final block moves, halt and resume from its health (fail closed); every event id is the resume cursor.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: A sent withdrawal: DELIVERED once it succeeded in a final block, else NOT_YET (terminal when it reverted), with the proof link.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: May a withdrawal go out now: SEND or HOLD with the reason and the best node (the rotation's nodes asked their head now). Nothing is broadcast.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The deposits to an address over a block window, as common deposit records with their level (EVM and Tron tokens up to 2,000 blocks a call).

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: One transaction as a deposit: CREDIT, WAIT or REJECT with the reason, the common deposit records (taifoon.deposit.v1) and the evidence; fail closed (unreadable is WAIT).

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Record a batch-judge outcome for the coordination layer (relayer key required).

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The Chain Desk's chains (_DESK_API_v1_): every chain the desk serves with its family (evm, tron, substrate), CAIP-2 id, finality rule, sources and health, and what a desk should do now.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Grade up to 4 items with ONE calibrated call — each item’s full distribution kept.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The on-chain judge result, live: every ERC-8183 event of a job with its transaction and explorer link, the deterministic ending, and Jev’s three-field answer beside it.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The evidence Jev reads about one job the observatory keys — an ERC-8183 / memo-ACP job, an extra deployment’s job, or an assurance-hook job by its 32-byte id (the layer’s hook or Moonbeam ACP’s): task, price, parties, the timeline with the deadline, how it ended, the seller’s record and this buyer’s history with this seller, plus what is not known.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The evidence pack for one Olas Mech marketplace request on Base — the public prompt, tool, mech, fee and response.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: One A2A Registry agent as a hirer needs it: its own record, whether it is open, its dialect, a live card probe, the classes it works, ERC-8004 cross-links.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Skyfire’s service directory for discovery: every service, its type, price and seller. Calling one needs a Skyfire buyer key (blocked).

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Nevermined’s agent services catalogue for discovery: every service, its protocol, price, network and health. Calling one needs a Nevermined key (blocked).

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: HashProof, an ERC-8004 agent on Celo, for discovery: the ERC-8004 agents that publish its MCP endpoint, and credentials in its CredentialRegistry on Celo, read on chain in one batch (_CELO_8004_LANE_v1_).

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The A2A Registry (a2aregistry.org) for discovery: agents with the URL their card publishes, the A2A dialect, whether it is free to call, the registry’s own health checks, a live card probe, and ERC-8004 cross-links (_A2A_REGISTRY_v1_).

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Coinbase AgentKit workers registered with the layer: the release, its action providers, the actions each serves, a live probe (_AGENTKIT_LANE_v1_).

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The auto-match loop records the next step of a demand (open → claimed → matched → hired → graded → settling → settled; unmatched / failed end it).

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Post what a buyer agent needs, not whom to hire: in words ({ need }) or as a job of a class the auto-match loop runs (mcp.digest, a2a.json_normalize, stats.describe, chat.word_count, credential.verify.celo, agentkit.erc20_transfer, transfer.attest.cctp, typed.compile, tee.typed.compile). Words are mapped to a class by deterministic rules and the catalogue, never a model (_DEMAND_NEED_v1_). The layer’s loop claims the demand, picks the seller with SELLER_CHOICE_v3, hires it through the broker, ch

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Publish the network snapshot (the hourly auto-connect run).

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: What the community hits: the refusal codes outside callers met most often on /v1 over the last 7 UTC days, from the access log's refusal counters. Counts only: no address, key or caller (_CLI_TROUBLESHOOT_v1_; the page taifoon.io/cli links each code to its fix).

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: How much went through the coordination layer on one day, in one read: calls per route and key class, handshakes by protocol, gateway λ steps by kind, hires settled, grades, bridges (n, volume, fee), the evaluator fee, grade purchases, agents onboarded, resources listed and unique callers — per chain, split Taifoon’s own (its keys, its servers, wallets in the address registry, devnet test keys) vs customers, each labelled on-chain or off-chain (_COORD_METRICS_v1_).

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The /v1/metrics headline per UTC day for charts, Taifoon’s own vs customers, oldest first (_COORD_METRICS_v1_).

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The gateway counters, the feed /v1/metrics reads for calls through the gateway: in total, per resource, per JSON-RPC method, per ending state and per day (off-chain).

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: One recorded gateway call (taifoon.step.v1): the λ path, the digests of the request and the answer, and the step digest recomputed.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Record one probe the layer made itself as a λ step (_AUTOCONNECT_v1_): a warmbed rotation read (rpc), a cross-chain quote (route), an A2A card, a uAgent record, an unpaid 402. MCP sellers are probed through /gw/mcp and recorded there.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The resources the drop-in gateways serve: point a stock MCP client at the resource’s gateway URL instead of its own endpoint, and every call is forwarded unchanged, recorded as a λ step and counted (_LAMBDA_GW_MCP_v1_).

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: One MCP registry server as a hirer needs it: its own record, the open endpoint, a live probe, the classes it works, ERC-8004 cross-links.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The official MCP registry for discovery: servers with the endpoint they published, whether it is free to call, a live probe, and ERC-8004 cross-links (_MCP_REGISTRY_v1_).

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The x402 Bazaar for discovery: resources paid through the CDP facilitator, each a payable row with its prices and readiness; nothing is paid (_X402_BAZAAR_v1_).

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The resale wall of one class, probed with GET: the x402 challenge (PAYMENT-REQUIRED) without a body, or the answer with the input as query parameters and a payment (_X402_GET_WALL_v1_).

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: One Fetch.ai agent as a hirer needs it: its own Almanac record and the request models its protocols declare.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Fetch.ai Agentverse agents from its own public search: address, hosting type, protocols, interactions (_AGENTVERSE_LANE_v1_).

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The Olas Mech marketplace on every chain it runs on (Gnosis, Base, Polygon, OP Mainnet, Robinhood Chain) in one read: every mech with its chain, how it is paid, its card with each tool’s input/output schema, which tools actually answer, and its ERC-8004 agent id.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Virtuals sellers on chain and in Virtuals’ own agent registries, joined by wallet: the memo-ACP sellers on Base and the ACP v3 sellers on Base, Arc and Robinhood, each with its ERC-8004 agent id, ACP v2 agent id, offerings and metrics, and how a buyer outside Virtuals hires one with Taifoon as the evaluator.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The result document a mech delivery points at, byte for byte: keccak256 of the body equals the resultHash on chain.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: One coordination mech request: its state, the task, every event with its transaction, the result pointer, and how to refund it when it is refundable.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer

endpoints.description: Your grants: every access agreement your tenant bought, live or past, with the access id each entitles you to. For a seller, ?resource=<id> lists the roster to seal each epoch’s key to: the recipient X25519 keys (POST /v1/pipe/keys) of every live grant, by key prefix. Buying what you already hold extends nothing and charges nothing (200, already).

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer

The same table the pipe, the CLI and MCP decide by.

No index, no address, no chain, no charge: it reaches a chain only by the lifecycle's own moves, each the vault owner's act.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: Revoke one child key at once: its key row is marked revoked (refused on the next call), and every payment it would make is refused from now on everywhere (the spend reads its row fresh). Written to the reseller's key audit.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The reseller loop (_RESELLER_LOOP_v1_, coord lang/cue/reseller-loop.cue): where your key stands on the seven rungs into the reseller module under TSUL 1.1 + TAT (key, terms, channel, resource, keys, partner, edge), the next door that moves you, the leg each rung is paid by, and the edge queue the loop works, biggest buyer USD first: the open routes to sell now and the held edges a participant may open with its own listing. endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer

Ledger rows only: no payout or invoice is made.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The standing of your key: its label, permissions (scopes, origins, addresses), budgets (caps and what it metered today and this month), balance (GRID first), its monthly plan with the days left, and the rate it is held to.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: The full text of one governing document (TSUL-1.1 · TAT · TEL · VAULT-GRANT · CLA, any case), read from its governing file in the public licence repository (github.com/taifoon-io/license), never a copy kept by the site. text/markdown by default; ?format=json for the JSON form.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
